whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Waffcha,

I noticed your dessert cafe has incredible 4.3★ ratings across 1,026+ reviews in Anandpuri, Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile-friendly menu and quick WhatsApp ordering page.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, bestseller waffles showcase, aur location/timings integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://waffcha-patna-demo.netlify.app

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Waffcha, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke dessert cafe (Waffcha - The European Dessert) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp ordering and your bestseller waffles showcase for Anandpuri, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu, pricing, aur actual photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
